user.title: ARD Sounds
user.description: Browse ARD radio and podcasts in the media browser. Podcasts without published episodes are hidden. No ARD account is required.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to ARD Sounds. Please try again later.

init.title: ARD Sounds
init.description: Manage browsing preferences and shared starred podcasts. Stars are saved locally in Home Assistant.

data_description.page_size: Enter a whole number between 10 and 100. Letter folders show all matching podcasts.
data_description.episode_limit: Enter a whole number between 10 and 100.
data_description.sonos_compatibility: Use audio content types for episodes and radio streams so they appear in the Sonos media browser. Disabled by default.

add_star.title: Star a podcast
add_star.description: Search for a podcast by name. Empty and already starred podcasts are excluded. For many matches, narrow your search to find the podcast you want.

choose_star.title: Choose a podcast
choose_star.description: Results for “{query}”. Select a podcast and submit to star it.

remove_stars.title: Remove starred podcasts
remove_stars.description: Select podcasts to unstar. Temporarily empty or unavailable podcasts remain in this list until you remove them.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to search ARD Sounds. Please try again later.
error.cannot_save: Unable to save your stars. Please try again.
error.invalid_query: Enter a podcast name of 1–200 characters.
error.no_results: No unstarred podcasts with published episodes were found. Try a more specific search.
error.invalid_selection: Select at least one valid podcast.

abort.not_loaded: ARD Sounds must be loaded to manage stars.
abort.no_stars: You have no starred podcasts yet.

reload_sources.name: Reload sources
reload_sources.description: Clear and refresh cached station and podcast metadata.

star_podcast.name: Star podcast
star_podcast.description: Save a podcast to the shared local starred collection. Repeating this action is safe.

podcast_id.name: Podcast ID
podcast_id.description: A numeric show ID, core ID, or media-source://ard_sounds/show/... ID.

unstar_podcast.name: Unstar podcast
unstar_podcast.description: Remove a podcast from the shared local starred collection, including when ARD is unavailable.

podcast_id.name: Podcast ID
podcast_id.description: A saved numeric show ID, core ID, or media-source://ard_sounds/show/... ID.

reload_failed.message: ARD sources could not be fully reloaded. Please try again.

cannot_connect.message: Unable to connect to ARD Sounds.

browse_failed.message: Unable to browse ARD content. Check the connection and selection.

invalid_star_storage.message: Saved ARD podcast selections have an invalid storage format.

star_failed.message: Unable to load or update starred ARD podcasts. Please try again.

unavailable_podcast.message: This podcast is no longer available.
